description:
This schematic map illustrates a typical coastal lagoon landscape, depicting distinct land cover and water body classifications. The legend defines four classes:
- Light blue represents "Lagoon", corresponding to the area labelled "8.3.1 Lagoons" which is the primary water body in the centre of the schematic.
- Beige represents "Sand bank", corresponding to the land barrier labelled "6.2.1 Beaches and Dunes" that partially encloses the lagoon.
- Olive green represents "Vegetated area", shown as a small segment at the northern tip of the land barrier.
- Dark blue represents "Sea and Ocean", encompassing the larger water body surrounding the land barrier and the lagoon. A specific portion of the dark blue area to the right of the sand bank is labelled "8.4.2 Coastal waters".

The diagram shows the "8.3.1 Lagoons" (light blue) separated from the "Sea and Ocean" (dark blue) by a narrow land barrier. This barrier is primarily composed of "6.2.1 Beaches and Dunes" (beige), with a small "Vegetated area" (olive green) at its northernmost point. The codes (e.g., 8.3.1, 6.2.1, 8.4.2) likely refer to a land cover/land use classification system such as CORINE Land Cover (CLC) or CLC+. No geographic scale, compass, or specific date is indicated.
